title: Rave Ghost Linndrum
description: A dense LinnDrum breakbeat hammers in at full tilt, chopped and ghost-hatted under roaring off-beat dub chord stabs that walk a minor progression. After an early peak the track deconstructs into delay-soaked stabs and ratcheting break fragments, gritty and rave-nostalgic to the last.
code:
setcpm(150/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.0).shape(0.3),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.6).cut(1).crush(8),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(700).room(0.4).delay(".4:.166:.6").gain(0.5)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.0).shape(0.35),
    s("hh*3 hh hh*5 hh").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.55).cut(1).crush(7).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)),
    s("~ rim ~ [rim rim]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).speed(1.2),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(1200).room(0.4).delay(".4:.166:.6").shape(0.3).gain(0.5)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.0).shape(0.4).every(4, x => x.ply("<1 1 2 4>")),
    s("hh(7,16,3)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.55).cut(1).crush(6).swingBy(0.08,8),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.6).room(0.3),
    s("[oh ~]*2").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.4).cut(1),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(900,2400)).resonance(8).room(0.4).delay(".4:.166:.6").vowel("<a e o>").gain(0.5).struct("~ x ~ x"),
    note("<c2 ab1 f1 g1>").s("square").lpf(500).gain(0.45)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*2 ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.0).shape(0.45).ply("<1 2 1 4>"),
    s("hh*8").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).cut(1).crush(5).degradeBy(0.3),
    s("~ cp ~ [cp cp]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.6).room(0.3),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(2600).resonance(10).room(0.4).delay(".4:.166:.6").shape(0.4).gain(0.5).struct("~ x ~ x").off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.35)),
    note("<c2 ab1 f1 g1>").s("square").lpf(700).shape(0.3).gain(0.5)
  )],
  [20, stack(
    s("sd(3,8,1)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.7).crush(4).room(0.4).delay(".5:.25:.7"),
    s("hh(5,8)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.45).cut(1).crush(8).degradeBy(0.4),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(500,1800)).resonance(9).room(0.6).delay(".5:.25:.75").vowel("<o a>").gain(0.5).struct("x ~ ~ x")
  )],
  [18, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ sd").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.85).shape(0.3).every(3, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("hh(3,8)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.4).cut(1).crush(7),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(900).room(0.5).delay(".5:.25:.7").gain(0.45).struct("~ x ~ ~")
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.7).shape(0.25),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> ~ ~").s("sawtooth").lpf(600).room(0.6).delay(".5:.25:.7").gain(0.4)
  )]
)
